description: Harbor execution envelope for D7Y eval trials on local Docker. Records the CPU, memory, storage, timeout, user, and network posture every baseline/treatment arm must share. Validated by evals/harbor/scripts/posture.py.

storage_enforcement.basis: local Docker uses overlay2 on an ext4 data root with no XFS/project-quota support, and Harbor passes storage_mb through only on quota-capable providers; the declared value is retained as task metadata, never treated as enforced

harbor_task_mapping.environment: network_mode="no-network", cpus=2, memory_mb=4096, storage_mb=10240, docker_image=<agent image>
harbor_task_mapping.verifier: timeout_sec=120, user="verifier", environment_mode="separate", environment={network_mode="no-network", docker_image=<verifier image>}
